title: A guard's remedy text never reaches the owner
why: The owner asked (page ask ask-mw6pwif5wv, 12:09 CST Nov 7) why guard instructions meant for a session reached his page. The Unvetted remedy text was passed to him as is.
note: Coordinator pick 12:26 CST: the leak was the Stop-hook block reason from lint/report_guard.py (UNVETTED_REASON plus CORRECTION_TAIL), not a page write. Done check: a red test where a report_guard Stop reason carries session-instruction wording; green once each reason opens with one plain owner-safe line and cites a record for the session's steps; verdicts unchanged.
